comment: Hand-crafted: the Doctor query of gh dojo doctor. The data shape follows the GraphQL schema (viewer, repository); X-OAuth-Scopes is the header GitHub sends for classic tokens, which recording does not keep. A token with neither project scope. The labels fields (dojoConfig: the kanban preset's area_prefix "area:", no types) are the real API's answer for Trum-ok/gh-dojo, saved by hand.
